# Airlock

> Sub-15ms zero-trust workstation sandbox for AI coding agents and package managers using Apple Seatbelt, Landlock LSM, and seccomp.

## Core Capabilities
- Sub-15ms Cold Start: Executes directly via kernel containment primitives without virtualization or daemon overhead.
- Platform Native Sandboxing: Apple Seatbelt (`sandbox-exec`) on macOS, Landlock LSM and seccomp-bpf on Linux.
- 18+ Package Manager Profiles: Out-of-the-box isolation for npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, uv, cargo, go, maven, gradle, swift, dotnet.
- Strict Credential Quarantine: Denies reads and writes to `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.gnupg`, Keychains.
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server: Stdio MCP tool provider for AI coding assistants.

## CLI Usage
- `airlock run -- <command>`: Executes command under kernel-enforced sandbox.
- `airlock run --profile <name> -- <command>`: Forces specific isolation profile.
- `airlock doctor`: Probes host kernel sandbox features and capabilities.
- `airlock audit --last`: Displays recent denied syscalls and file access attempts.

## Key Files & Paths
- Audit Log: `~/.airlock/audit.log`
- Configuration: `airlock.yaml`
- Documentation: README.md & AGENTS.md
